newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares end sharply on renewed confidence.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end sharply on renewed confidence.

text.p: Shenzhen shares ended sharply up on Monday on renewed confidence after an official newspaper said last Friday that excessive speculation on the stock markets had been effectively checked, traders said.
The B share index ended up 12.85 points or 9.03 percent to 155.19 on volume of 73.4 million shares worth HK$375 million.
The A share index went up 24.1 points or 7.25 percent to 356.4 on volume of 925.2 million shares worth 9.5 billion yuan.
A commentary by the People's Daily, the mouthpiece of the Communist Party, said last Friday that after a recent crackdown on the stock markets, excessive speculation had been checked.
"The day's surges were due to that commentary, which was interpreted by investors as a sign that Beijing does not intend to take new measures to further cool down stock trading," an analyst said.
Brokers said that the markets needed a period to digest today's rises and that buying would generally shift to shares in firms likely to report strong results for 1996.
On the B market, Shenzhen Zhonghao closed at its limit-up of HK$4.24 on volume of 465,521 shares on speculative buying.
Health Mineral Water followed suit, ending at HK$4.08 on volume of 460,008 shares.
The Shenzhen-based Securities Times reported on Monday that Health Mineral Water aimed to have annual sales of five billion yuan on output of one million tonnes by the year 2000.
Changan Automobile traded the most on volume of 5.11 million shares and rose HK$0.44 to HK$4.85 on demand by domestic institutions, brokers said.
On the A share market, automobile parts maker Zhuzhou Torch rose 0.43 yuan to its daily limit-up of 4.68 yuan.
